name: Maximilian Weber
bio:
Maximilian's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, watching DTM races with his grandfather. He was captivated not just by the speed, but by the artistry of the cars, especially the intricate paint jobs. After completing a rigorous apprenticeship at a leading automotive refinishing company in Stuttgart, he sought opportunities to combine his technical skills with his passion for racing. He quickly impressed with his meticulous attention to detail and knack for innovative paint solutions. Maximilian believes that a flawless paint job is crucial, not just for aesthetics, but for aerodynamics and brand representation. 

He's known for pushing the boundaries of paint technology, experimenting with new materials and techniques to achieve the perfect finish. His experience extends from traditional spraying to advanced techniques like hydrographics and ceramic coatings. Maximilian is a firm believer in collaboration, working closely with engineers and designers to ensure the paint enhances both the performance and the visual impact of each vehicle. He's eager to contribute his unique skill set to a team that values quality and innovation.

Despite his youth, Maximilian has already built an impressive portfolio and is known throughout some smaller German racing circles. His dedication to perfection is relentless, often leading him to work late into the night, ensuring that every surface is flawless. He's a true visionary in the art of motorsport vehicle aesthetics.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left side
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height with a lean build, often seen sporting protective eyewear.

quirks: Obsessively cleans his spray guns after every use, regardless of how small the job.
Always listens to classical music while working to maintain focus and precision.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets representing his favorite drivers.
